findings.title: Manifest still advertises ready while active bundle changes wait for evaluation
evidence: CHANGELOG.md: no entry for audit/numbering capability
findings.impact: The source bundle can appear releasable while a new capability is not independently evaluated.
findings.remediation: Obtain independent evaluation, close state/evidence, then update VERSION, manifest and CHANGELOG or mark status as release_candidate.

findings.title: Spec 002 run-state status conflicts with current phase and task ledger
findings.impact: A resumed agent may misread the initiative as draft despite the implementation being complete and awaiting evaluation.
findings.remediation: Synchronize run-state status or split phase/status explicitly in the schema and validator.

findings.title: Hard mirrors are documented more broadly than they are implemented
evidence: Only scripts/validate_bundle.py and smoke_test_scaffolder.py are executable local checks
findings.impact: The harness is governed but not hardened; critical invariants still depend partly on agent compliance.
findings.remediation: Add deterministic checks for spec index consistency, evidence-before-done, evaluator identity, approval gates and graph reachability.

findings.title: Older skills are below the newly documented production-ready skill anatomy
evidence: Several SKILL.md files lack explicit Inputs, External Knowledge, MCP, Tool Policy or Gotchas sections
findings.impact: Skill activation and portability are adequate for current use but weaker than the standard the bundle now teaches.
findings.remediation: Normalize skills by risk level using the sdd-harness-audit skill as the stronger reference.

findings.title: Agent role documents are heterogeneous
evidence: Some agent docs lack explicit Output or normalized Non-responsibilities sections
New audit agents are more complete than older role files
findings.impact: Subagent delegation and review outputs are less predictable across roles.
findings.remediation: Standardize every agent file with Mission, Responsibilities, Non-responsibilities, Inputs/Context, Output and Blocking/Escalation.

findings.title: Acceptance criteria evidence is stale
findings.impact: Release evidence no longer describes the current validation surface.
findings.remediation: Refresh release evidence after independent evaluation of current changes.

findings.title: No implemented hooks or CI workflows were found
evidence: scripts/validate_bundle.py exists but is not wired to detected hook/CI
scripts/smoke_test_scaffolder.py exists but is not wired to detected hook/CI
findings.impact: Deterministic checks depend on manual execution unless a consumer or maintainer wires them into hooks or CI.
findings.remediation: Add optional pre-commit/pre-push hooks or CI examples for validate_bundle.py, smoke_test_scaffolder.py and future state/graph validators.

findings.title: Terminal output shows mojibake for some Portuguese text
evidence: Terminal reads of README.md and .harness/AGENTS.md showed escaped/garbled accents
findings.impact: Low operational risk, but it can reduce readability in CLI-based audits.
findings.remediation: Confirm UTF-8 handling and prefer ASCII section anchors for machine-parsed headings.
